entry.title: Now fixed: Users might be unable to sign in to OWA or send emails on Exchange Server
entry.summary: Started with KB5126655. Fixed in KB5131090. Affects: Windows Server 2022, Windows Server 2025, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/release-health/status-windows-server-2022#5047msgdesc. From Microsoft release health.
